---
title: "linkedmice"
subtitle: "Survey-weighted two-table MICE imputation for linked household–person data"
---

`linkedmice` jointly imputes categorical variables across two linked tables — a
*household* table and a *person* table joined by a household key — using
gradient-boosted tree models (LightGBM by default) weighted by survey expansion
factors. It distinguishes item non-response (`NaN`, imputed) from structural
skips (a sentinel category, frozen and excluded from training), and refreshes
cross-table features between imputation blocks each iteration.

See the [design and usage guide](docs/imputer.md) and the worked example —
imputing the Mexico Census 2020 extended questionnaire (Jalisco) — under
`scripts/`, with validation reports in [docs/](docs/full_run_report.qmd).
